parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a sample-app path. Per the restraint rules, any record under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers a sample-app-mirror no-action regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplicate in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' (package: DebugPanel) is the production definition; the Wallpaper package copy is a local convenience replica for the sample app. Merging them would couple the production DebugPanel package to sample-app demonstration semantics.
